hints.title: Area Sum and Corner Multiplicity Invariants
hints.text: A set of rectangles forms a perfect rectangle if total individual area matches the bounding box area and internal corners cancel out in pairs.

hints.title: Vertex Parity Tracking in Point Collection
hints.text: Insert all four corners of each rectangle into a collection, toggling membership so that shared inner vertices cancel out completely.

hints.title: Bounding Box and Corner Set Equivalence
hints.text: Calculate sum of all rectangle areas. Track global min and max x and y. Toggle corners in a set. Verify sum of areas equals (max_x - min_x) * (max_y - min_y) and corner set contains exactly the 4 bounding corners.

complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and linear O(N) auxiliary space using corner cancellation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise geometric intersection checks require quadratic O(N^2) comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Corner parity hashing tests coverage and overlap simultaneously without segment trees.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check both total area conservation and exact 4-corner boundary matching.
